text:
deploy-bot: Automatic hold applied to release v2025.04.17 (canary) due to linked incident INC-4322. All new deploys in the active change window are paused. Reason: query-router circuit errors :warning:
oncall-bot: Incident created: <https://incidents.redwood.example/INC-4322|INC-4322> - Query router 5xx spike in eu-west-1.
marta: Copy, thanks. Which groups are impacted?
alex: Canary hosts in eu-west-1 only AFAICT. No global DB errors.
jordan: If canary is paused, do we want to pin the rollout to previous stable tag to avoid cascading config drift?
sam: Suggest we split the remaining rollout: allow non-eu regions to proceed, hold eu zones. Need approval from ops-sre.
ops-sre: +1 to split. We should not proceed with any traffic shifting in eu until query-router is green.
release-manager: OK. Plan: 1) abort canary in eu-west, 2) patch release notes with hold, 3) schedule a follow-up window for eu only. Proposed follow-up: 2025-04-17 22:00 UTC. Thoughts? :calendar:
alex: For aborting canary, run: 
```
./deploybot abort --release v2025.04.17 --env canary --region eu-west-1
```
will that cleanly revert in-flight warmups?
ops-sre: That command will stop the canary rollout. We should also rollback the live canary pods to stable image: 
```
kubectl -n prod set image deploy/query-router query-router=redwood/query-router:stable --selector=region=eu-west-1
```
Coordinate with infra.
release-manager: @ops-sre can you take the rollback? If you confirm, I'll update the release tracker and pause the change window for eu.
ops-sre: Taking it now. Patching in 2 mins.
oncall-bot: Incident INC-4322 updated: query-router error rate down 60% but still above threshold.
marta: Thanks. Once ops confirms, I will update the release notes and ping product for any messaging.
devex: Please include the abbr note for devs: "eu canary paused due to INC-4322; non-eu rollout continues" and link to the incident.
jordan: If eu is split out, we should also set a temporary version pin for the config-layer to avoid auto-upgrades: config.version=2025-04-stable.
release-manager: Agreed. I'll add the pin and schedule the eu-only window: new window 2025-04-17 22:00-23:00 UTC. If incident cleared earlier we can accelerate. Posting update in release tracker and #general.
alex: All good from infra side. ops-sre reported rollback complete.
ops-sre: Rollback done, canary pods replaced, healthchecks green.
release-manager: Final: hold lifted for non-eu, eu remains paused until 22:00 UTC or incident auto-clear. I'll post a separate thread if we need to re-extend the hold. Thanks all :thumbsup:
